input.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient
input.rationale: The only licence to us (paragraph 2) is granted to "Customer" alone, with no coverage for AP affiliates or contractors who in practice operate our websites and ad stack, and it is expressly "revocable" and "non-transferable, non-assignable" — i.e. Kubient could pull platform access at will mid-Term, contrary to the playbook requirement that a subscription licence be revocable only for uncured material breach/termination. Paragraph 4 already gives both parties defined termination rights (30-day cure for material breach; 90 days after the Initial Term) and paragraph 9(h) already lets either party assign to an affiliate or M&A successor, so making the licence irrevocable except on termination under paragraph 4 and transferable to a successor is consistent with the existing bargain; paragraph 21(c)(ii) continues to revoke the licence on termination. Redline adds affiliate/contractor coverage, deletes "revocable", and adds successor transfer while retaining the no-sublicense restriction.

proposal.summary: Extend Auction Platform licence to AP affiliates and contractors, remove at-will revocability, and permit transfer to a successor
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Auction Platform licence to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, since they operate our sites and ad stack, and replaced the at-will "revocable/non-transferable" language with irrevocability for the Term (revocation only on termination under paragraph 4) plus transfer to a successor, consistent with the assignment right in paragraph 9(h). If helpful, we can accept affiliate coverage on written notice to Kubient as a fallback.

ops.oldText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform
ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer, its affiliates and its contractors acting on Customer's behalf a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive license, without right of sublicense, transferable to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or sale of all or substantially all of Customer's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement, and irrevocable except upon termination of this Agreement in accordance with paragraph 4, to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform
